tier_history.note: Initial listing. Anonymous read-only provider of UK and international defence and aerospace jobs (search_jobs, get_job_detail, get_employer_context, begin_application as an apply-link redirect, and jobsnap:application_brief). Applications are made on the employer's own page. ES256-signed manifest with keys at /.well-known/ojcp-keys.json; domain control by DNS TXT (ojcp-registry-verification). Rate limit declared in the manifest. Requesting review for the verified tier.
